enumDescriptions: Turn off Word Based Suggestions.
Turn off Word Based Suggestions when Inline Suggestions are present.
Only suggest words from the active document.
Suggest words from all open documents of the same language.
Suggest words from all open documents.
editor.wordBasedSuggestions.description: Controls whether completions should be computed based on words in the document and from which documents they are computed.

enumDescriptions: Semantic highlighting enabled for all color themes.
Semantic highlighting disabled for all color themes.
Semantic highlighting is configured by the current color theme's `semanticHighlighting` setting.
editor.semanticHighlighting.enabled.description: Controls whether the semanticHighlighting is shown for the languages that support it.

editor.stablePeek.markdownDescription: Keep peek editors open even when double-clicking their content or when hitting `Escape`.

editor.maxTokenizationLineLength.description: Lines above this length will not be tokenized for performance reasons

editor.experimental.asyncTokenization.description: Controls whether the tokenization should happen asynchronously on a web worker.

editor.experimental.asyncTokenizationLog.description: Controls whether async tokenization should be logged. For debugging only.

editor.experimental.asyncTokenizationVer.description: Controls whether async tokenization should be verified against legacy background tokenization. Might slow down tokenization. For debugging only.

editor.experimental.treeSitterTelemetry.markdownDescription: Controls whether tree sitter parsing should be turned on and telemetry collected. Setting `#editor.experimental.preferTreeSitter#` for specific languages will take precedence.

editor.experimental.preferTreeSitter.css.markdownDescription: Controls whether tree sitter parsing should be turned on for css. This will take precedence over `#editor.experimental.treeSitterTelemetry#` for css.

editor.experimental.preferTreeSitter.typ.markdownDescription: Controls whether tree sitter parsing should be turned on for typescript. This will take precedence over `#editor.experimental.treeSitterTelemetry#` for typescript.

editor.experimental.preferTreeSitter.ini.markdownDescription: Controls whether tree sitter parsing should be turned on for ini. This will take precedence over `#editor.experimental.treeSitterTelemetry#` for ini.

editor.experimental.preferTreeSitter.reg.markdownDescription: Controls whether tree sitter parsing should be turned on for regex. This will take precedence over `#editor.experimental.treeSitterTelemetry#` for regex.

editor.language.brackets.description: Defines the bracket symbols that increase or decrease the indentation.

items.description: The opening bracket character or string sequence.
The closing bracket character or string sequence.

editor.language.colorizedBracketPairs.description: Defines the bracket pairs that are colorized by their nesting level if bracket pair colorization is enabled.

items.description: The opening bracket character or string sequence.
The closing bracket character or string sequence.

diffEditor.maxComputationTime.description: Timeout in milliseconds after which diff computation is cancelled. Use 0 for no timeout.

diffEditor.maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size in MB for which to compute diffs. Use 0 for no limit.

diffEditor.renderSideBySide.description: Controls whether the diff editor shows the diff side by side or inline.

diffEditor.renderSideBySideInlineBreakpo.description: If the diff editor width is smaller than this value, the inline view is used.

diffEditor.useInlineViewWhenSpaceIsLimit.description: If enabled and the editor width is too small, the inline view is used.

diffEditor.renderMarginRevertIcon.description: When enabled, the diff editor shows arrows in its glyph margin to revert changes.

diffEditor.renderGutterMenu.description: When enabled, the diff editor shows a special gutter for revert and stage actions.

diffEditor.ignoreTrimWhitespace.description: When enabled, the diff editor ignores changes in leading or trailing whitespace.

diffEditor.renderIndicators.description: Controls whether the diff editor shows +/- indicators for added/removed changes.

diffEditor.codeLens.description: Controls whether the editor shows CodeLens.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Lines will wrap at the viewport width.
Lines will wrap according to the `#editor.wordWrap#` setting.
Uses the advanced diffing algorithm from the external `@vscode/diff` package (pure JavaScript).
Uses the advanced diffing algorithm from the external `@vscode/diff` package (WebAssembly).

diffEditor.hideUnchangedRegions.enabled.markdownDescription: Controls whether the diff editor shows unchanged regions.

diffEditor.hideUnchangedRegions.revealLi.markdownDescription: Controls how many lines are used for unchanged regions.

diffEditor.hideUnchangedRegions.minimumL.markdownDescription: Controls how many lines are used as a minimum for unchanged regions.

diffEditor.hideUnchangedRegions.contextL.markdownDescription: Controls how many lines are used as context when comparing unchanged regions.

diffEditor.experimental.showMoves.markdownDescription: Controls whether the diff editor should show detected code moves.

diffEditor.experimental.showEmptyDecorat.description: Controls whether the diff editor shows empty decorations to see where characters got inserted or deleted.

diffEditor.experimental.useTrueInlineVie.description: If enabled and the editor uses the inline view, word changes are rendered inline.

editor.acceptSuggestionOnCommitCharacter.markdownDescription: Controls whether suggestions should be accepted on commit characters. For example, in JavaScript, the semi-colon (`;`) can be a commit character that accepts a suggestion and types that character.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Only accept a suggestion with `Enter` when it makes a textual change.
editor.acceptSuggestionOnEnter.markdownDescription: Controls whether suggestions should be accepted on `Enter`, in addition to `Tab`. Helps to avoid ambiguity between inserting new lines or accepting suggestions.

enumDescriptions: Use platform APIs to detect when a Screen Reader is attached.
Optimize for usage with a Screen Reader.
Assume a screen reader is not attached.
editor.accessibilitySupport.description: Controls if the UI should run in a mode where it is optimized for screen readers.

editor.accessibilityPageSize.description: Controls the number of lines in the editor that can be read out by a screen reader at once. When we detect a screen reader we automatically set the default to be 500. Warning: this has a performance implication for numbers larger than the default.

editor.allowVariableLineHeights.description: Controls whether to allow using variable line heights in the editor.

editor.allowVariableFonts.description: Controls whether to allow using variable fonts in the editor.

editor.allowVariableFontsInAccessibility.description: Controls whether to allow using variable fonts in the editor in the accessibility mode.

enumDescriptions: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose brackets.
Autoclose brackets only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace.
editor.autoClosingBrackets.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically close brackets after the user adds an opening bracket.

enumDescriptions: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose comments.
Autoclose comments only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace.
editor.autoClosingComments.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically close comments after the user adds an opening comment.

editor.screenReaderAnnounceInlineSuggest.description: Control whether inline suggestions are announced by a screen reader.

enumDescriptions: Remove adjacent closing quotes or brackets only if they were automatically inserted.
editor.autoClosingDelete.description: Controls whether the editor should remove adjacent closing quotes or brackets when deleting.

enumDescriptions: Type over closing quotes or brackets only if they were automatically inserted.
editor.autoClosingOvertype.description: Controls whether the editor should type over closing quotes or brackets.

enumDescriptions: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose quotes.
Autoclose quotes only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace.
editor.autoClosingQuotes.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically close quotes after the user adds an opening quote.

enumDescriptions: The editor will not insert indentation automatically.
The editor will keep the current line's indentation.
The editor will keep the current line's indentation and honor language defined brackets.
The editor will keep the current line's indentation, honor language defined brackets and invoke special onEnterRules defined by languages.
The editor will keep the current line's indentation, honor language defined brackets, invoke special onEnterRules defined by languages, and honor indentationRules defined by languages.
editor.autoIndent.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically adjust the indentation when users type, paste, move or indent lines.

editor.autoIndentOnPaste.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically auto-indent the pasted content.

editor.autoIndentOnPasteWithinString.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically auto-indent the pasted content when pasted within a string. This takes effect when autoIndentOnPaste is true.

enumDescriptions: Use language configurations to determine when to automatically surround selections.
Surround with quotes but not brackets.
Surround with brackets but not quotes.
editor.autoSurround.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically surround selections when typing quotes or brackets.

editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled.markdownDescription: Controls whether bracket pair colorization is enabled or not. Use `#workbench.colorCustomizations#` to override the bracket highlight colors.

editor.bracketPairColorization.independe.description: Controls whether each bracket type has its own independent color pool.

enumDescriptions: Enables bracket pair guides.
Enables bracket pair guides only for the active bracket pair.
Disables bracket pair guides.
editor.guides.bracketPairs.description: Controls whether bracket pair guides are enabled or not.

enumDescriptions: Enables horizontal guides as addition to vertical bracket pair guides.
Enables horizontal guides only for the active bracket pair.
Disables horizontal bracket pair guides.
editor.guides.bracketPairsHorizontal.description: Controls whether horizontal bracket pair guides are enabled or not.

editor.guides.highlightActiveBracketPair.description: Controls whether the editor should highlight the active bracket pair.

editor.guides.indentation.description: Controls whether the editor should render indent guides.

enumDescriptions: Highlights the active indent guide.
Highlights the active indent guide even if bracket guides are highlighted.
Do not highlight the active indent guide.
editor.guides.highlightActiveIndentation.description: Controls whether the editor should highlight the active indent guide.

editor.codeLens.description: Controls whether the editor shows CodeLens.

editor.codeLensFontFamily.description: Controls the font family for CodeLens.

editor.codeLensFontSize.markdownDescription: Controls the font size in pixels for CodeLens. When set to 0, 90% of `#editor.fontSize#` is used.

editor.colorDecorators.description: Controls whether the editor should render the inline color decorators and color picker.

editor.colorDecoratorsLimit.markdownDescription: Controls the max number of color decorators that can be rendered in an editor at once.

editor.columnSelection.description: Enable that the selection with the mouse and keys is doing column selection.

editor.comments.insertSpace.description: Controls whether a space character is inserted when commenting.

editor.comments.ignoreEmptyLines.description: Controls if empty lines should be ignored with toggle, add or remove actions for line comments.

editor.copyWithSyntaxHighlighting.description: Controls whether syntax highlighting should be copied into the clipboard.

enumDescriptions: Smooth caret animation is disabled.
Smooth caret animation is enabled only when the user moves the cursor with an explicit gesture.
Smooth caret animation is always enabled.
editor.cursorSmoothCaretAnimation.description: Controls whether the smooth caret animation should be enabled.

editor.cursorStyle.description: Controls the cursor style in insert input mode.

editor.cursorSurroundingLines.description: Controls the minimal number of visible leading lines (minimum 0) and trailing lines (minimum 1) surrounding the cursor. Known as 'scrollOff' or 'scrollOffset' in some other editors.

enumDescriptions: `cursorSurroundingLines` is enforced only when triggered via the keyboard or API.
`cursorSurroundingLines` is enforced always.

editor.cursorWidth.markdownDescription: Controls the width of the cursor when `#editor.cursorStyle#` is set to `line`.

editor.cursorHeight.markdownDescription: Controls the height of the cursor when `#editor.cursorStyle#` is set to `line`. Cursor's max height depends on line height.

editor.dragAndDrop.description: Controls whether the editor should allow moving selections via drag and drop.

editor.dropIntoEditor.enabled.markdownDescription: Controls whether you can drag and drop a file into a text editor by holding down the `Shift` key (instead of opening the file in an editor).

editor.dropIntoEditor.showDropSelector.markdownDescription: Controls if a widget is shown when dropping files into the editor. This widget lets you control how the file is dropped.
enumDescriptions: Show the drop selector widget after a file is dropped into the editor.
Never show the drop selector widget. Instead the default drop provider is always used.

editor.editContext.description: Sets whether the EditContext API should be used instead of the text area to power input in the editor.

editor.emptySelectionClipboard.description: Controls whether copying without a selection copies the current line.

enumDescriptions: Use regular DOM-based rendering.
Use GPU acceleration.
editor.experimentalGpuAcceleration.description: Controls whether to use the experimental GPU acceleration to render the editor.

enumDescriptions: Use a new rendering method with svgs.
Use a new rendering method with font characters.
Use the stable rendering method.
editor.experimentalWhitespaceRendering.description: Controls whether whitespace is rendered with a new, experimental method.

editor.find.cursorMoveOnType.description: Controls whether the cursor should jump to find matches while typing.

enumDescriptions: Never seed search string from the editor selection.
Always seed search string from the editor selection, including word at cursor position.
Only seed search string from the editor selection.
editor.find.seedSearchStringFromSelectio.description: Controls whether the search string in the Find Widget is seeded from the editor selection.

enumDescriptions: Never turn on Find in Selection automatically (default).
Always turn on Find in Selection automatically.
Turn on Find in Selection automatically when multiple lines of content are selected.
editor.find.autoFindInSelection.description: Controls the condition for turning on Find in Selection automatically.

editor.find.globalFindClipboard.description: Controls whether the Find Widget should read or modify the shared find clipboard on macOS.

editor.find.addExtraSpaceOnTop.description: Controls whether the Find Widget should add extra lines on top of the editor. When true, you can scroll beyond the first line when the Find Widget is visible.

editor.find.loop.description: Controls whether the search automatically restarts from the beginning (or the end) when no further matches can be found.

editor.find.closeOnResult.description: Controls whether the Find Widget closes after an explicit find navigation command lands on a result.

enumDescriptions: Do not store search history from the find widget.
Store search history across the active workspace
editor.find.history.description: Controls how the find widget history should be stored

enumDescriptions: Do not store history from the replace widget.
Store replace history across the active workspace
editor.find.replaceHistory.description: Controls how the replace widget history should be stored

editor.find.findOnType.description: Controls whether the Find Widget should search as you type.

editor.folding.description: Controls whether the editor has code folding enabled.

enumDescriptions: Use a language-specific folding strategy if available, else the indentation-based one.
Use the indentation-based folding strategy.
editor.foldingStrategy.description: Controls the strategy for computing folding ranges.

editor.foldingHighlight.description: Controls whether the editor should highlight folded ranges.

editor.foldingImportsByDefault.description: Controls whether the editor automatically collapses import ranges.

editor.foldingMaximumRegions.description: The maximum number of foldable regions. Increasing this value may result in the editor becoming less responsive when the current source has a large number of foldable regions.

editor.unfoldOnClickAfterEndOfLine.description: Controls whether clicking on the empty content after a folded line will unfold the line.

anyOf.description: Enables/Disables font ligatures ('calt' and 'liga' font features). Change this to a string for fine-grained control of the 'font-feature-settings' CSS property.
Explicit 'font-feature-settings' CSS property. A boolean can be passed instead if one only needs to turn on/off ligatures.

editor.fontLigatures.description: Configures font ligatures or font features. Can be either a boolean to enable/disable ligatures or a string for the value of the CSS 'font-feature-settings' property.

editor.fontSize.description: Controls the font size in pixels.

anyOf.errorMessage: Only "normal" and "bold" keywords or numbers between 1 and 1000 are allowed.

editor.fontWeight.description: Controls the font weight. Accepts "normal" and "bold" keywords or numbers between 1 and 1000.

anyOf.description: Enables/Disables the translation from font-weight to font-variation-settings. Change this to a string for fine-grained control of the 'font-variation-settings' CSS property.
Explicit 'font-variation-settings' CSS property. A boolean can be passed instead if one only needs to translate font-weight to font-variation-settings.

editor.fontVariations.description: Configures font variations. Can be either a boolean to enable/disable the translation from font-weight to font-variation-settings or a string for the value of the CSS 'font-variation-settings' property.

editor.formatOnPaste.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically format the pasted content. A formatter must be available and the formatter should be able to format a range in a document.

editor.formatOnType.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically format the line after typing.

editor.glyphMargin.description: Controls whether the editor should render the vertical glyph margin.

editor.gotoLocation.multiple.deprecationMessage: This setting is deprecated, please use separate settings like 'editor.editor.gotoLocation.multipleDefinitions' or 'editor.editor.gotoLocation.multipleImplementations' instead.

editor.gotoLocation.multipleDefinitions.description: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Definition'-command when multiple target locations exist.
enumDescriptions: Show Peek view of the results (default)
Go to the primary result and show a Peek view
Go to the primary result and enable Peek-less navigation to others

editor.gotoLocation.multipleTypeDefiniti.description: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Type Definition'-command when multiple target locations exist.
enumDescriptions: Show Peek view of the results (default)
Go to the primary result and show a Peek view
Go to the primary result and enable Peek-less navigation to others

editor.gotoLocation.multipleDeclarations.description: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Declaration'-command when multiple target locations exist.
enumDescriptions: Show Peek view of the results (default)
Go to the primary result and show a Peek view
Go to the primary result and enable Peek-less navigation to others

editor.gotoLocation.multipleImplementati.description: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Implementations'-command when multiple target locations exist.
enumDescriptions: Show Peek view of the results (default)
Go to the primary result and show a Peek view
Go to the primary result and enable Peek-less navigation to others

editor.gotoLocation.multipleReferences.description: Controls the behavior the 'Go to References'-command when multiple target locations exist.
enumDescriptions: Show Peek view of the results (default)
Go to the primary result and show a Peek view
Go to the primary result and enable Peek-less navigation to others

editor.gotoLocation.alternativeDefinitio.description: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Definition' is the current location.

editor.gotoLocation.alternativeTypeDefin.description: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Type Definition' is the current location.

editor.gotoLocation.alternativeDeclarati.description: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Declaration' is the current location.

editor.gotoLocation.alternativeImplement.description: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Implementation' is the current location.

editor.gotoLocation.alternativeReference.description: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Reference' is the current location.

editor.hideCursorInOverviewRuler.description: Controls whether the cursor should be hidden in the overview ruler.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Hover is shown when holding `Command` or `Alt` (the opposite modifier of `#editor.multiCursorModifier#`)
editor.hover.enabled.description: Controls whether the hover is shown.

editor.hover.delay.description: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which the hover is shown.

editor.hover.sticky.description: Controls whether the hover should remain visible when mouse is moved over it.

editor.hover.hidingDelay.markdownDescription: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which the hover is hidden. Requires `#editor.hover.sticky#` to be enabled.

editor.hover.above.description: Prefer showing hovers above the line, if there's space.

editor.hover.showLongLineWarning.description: Controls whether long line warning hovers are shown, such as when tokenization is skipped or rendering is paused.

editor.inlineSuggest.enabled.description: Controls whether to automatically show inline suggestions in the editor.

enumDescriptions: Show the inline suggestion toolbar whenever an inline suggestion is shown.
Show the inline suggestion toolbar when hovering over an inline suggestion.
Never show the inline suggestion toolbar.
editor.inlineSuggest.showToolbar.description: Controls when to show the inline suggestion toolbar.

editor.inlineSuggest.syntaxHighlightingE.description: Controls whether to show syntax highlighting for inline suggestions in the editor.

editor.inlineSuggest.suppressSuggestions.description: Controls how inline suggestions interact with the suggest widget. If enabled, the suggest widget is not shown automatically when inline suggestions are available.

editor.inlineSuggest.suppressInSnippetMo.description: Controls whether inline suggestions are suppressed when in snippet mode.

editor.inlineSuggest.minShowDelay.description: Controls the minimal delay in milliseconds after which inline suggestions are shown after typing.

editor.inlineSuggest.experimental.suppre.description: Suppresses inline completions for specified extension IDs -- comma separated.

editor.inlineSuggest.experimental.emptyR.description: Controls whether to send request information from the inline suggestion provider.

editor.inlineSuggest.triggerCommandOnPro.description: Controls whether to trigger a command when the inline suggestion provider changes.

editor.inlineSuggest.experimental.showOn.description: Controls whether to show inline suggestions when there is a suggest conflict.

editor.inlineSuggest.fontFamily.description: Controls the font family of the inline suggestions.

editor.inlineSuggest.edits.allowCodeShif.description: Controls whether showing a suggestion will shift the code to make space for the suggestion inline.

editor.inlineSuggest.edits.showLongDista.description: Controls whether long distance inline suggestions are shown.

editor.inlineSuggest.edits.longDistanceH.description: Controls how many lines of surrounding context are shown above and below the target line in the long distance inline suggestion preview. Set to 0 to only show the target line.

editor.inlineSuggest.edits.renderSideByS.description: Controls whether larger suggestions can be shown side by side.
enumDescriptions: Larger suggestions will show side by side if there is enough space, otherwise they will be shown below.
Larger suggestions are never shown side by side and will always be shown below.

editor.inlineSuggest.edits.showCollapsed.description: Controls whether the suggestion will show as collapsed until jumping to it.

editor.letterSpacing.description: Controls the letter spacing in pixels.

enumDescriptions: Disable the code action menu.
Show the code action menu when the cursor is on lines with code.
Show the code action menu when the cursor is on lines with code or on empty lines.
editor.lightbulb.enabled.description: Enables the Code Action lightbulb in the editor.

editor.lineHeight.markdownDescription:
Controls the line height. 
 - Use 0 to automatically compute the line height from the font size.
 - Values between 0 and 8 will be used as a multiplier with the font size.
 - Values greater than or equal to 8 will be used as effective values.

enumDescriptions: Line numbers are not rendered.
Line numbers are rendered as absolute number.
Line numbers are rendered as distance in lines to cursor position.
Line numbers are rendered every 10 lines.
editor.lineNumbers.description: Controls the display of line numbers.

editor.linkedEditing.description: Controls whether the editor has linked editing enabled. Depending on the language, related symbols such as HTML tags, are updated while editing.

editor.links.description: Controls whether the editor should detect links and make them clickable.

editor.minimap.enabled.description: Controls whether the minimap is shown.

enumDescriptions: The minimap is always shown.
The minimap is hidden when mouse is not over the minimap and shown when mouse is over the minimap.
The minimap is only shown when the editor is scrolled
editor.minimap.autohide.description: Controls whether the minimap is hidden automatically.

enumDescriptions: The minimap has the same size as the editor contents (and might scroll).
The minimap will stretch or shrink as necessary to fill the height of the editor (no scrolling).
The minimap will shrink as necessary to never be larger than the editor (no scrolling).
editor.minimap.size.description: Controls the size of the minimap.

editor.minimap.side.description: Controls the side where to render the minimap.

editor.minimap.showSlider.description: Controls when the minimap slider is shown.

editor.minimap.scale.description: Scale of content drawn in the minimap: 1, 2 or 3.

editor.minimap.renderCharacters.description: Render the actual characters on a line as opposed to color blocks.

editor.minimap.maxColumn.description: Limit the width of the minimap to render at most a certain number of columns.

editor.minimap.showRegionSectionHeaders.description: Controls whether named regions are shown as section headers in the minimap.

editor.minimap.showMarkSectionHeaders.description: Controls whether MARK: comments are shown as section headers in the minimap.

editor.minimap.markSectionHeaderRegex.description: Defines the regular expression used to find section headers in comments. The regex must contain a named match group `label` (written as `(?<label>.+)`) that encapsulates the section header, otherwise it will not work. Optionally you can include another match group named `separator`. Use \n in the pattern to match multi-line headers.

editor.minimap.sectionHeaderFontSize.description: Controls the font size of section headers in the minimap.

editor.minimap.sectionHeaderLetterSpacin.description: Controls the amount of space (in pixels) between characters of section header. This helps the readability of the header in small font sizes.

editor.mouseWheelScrollSensitivity.markdownDescription: A multiplier to be used on the `deltaX` and `deltaY` of mouse wheel scroll events.

editor.mouseWheelZoom.markdownDescription: Zoom the font of the editor when using mouse wheel and holding `Cmd`.

editor.multiCursorMergeOverlapping.description: Merge multiple cursors when they are overlapping.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Maps to `Control` on Windows and Linux and to `Command` on macOS.
Maps to `Alt` on Windows and Linux and to `Option` on macOS.
editor.multiCursorModifier.markdownDescription: The modifier to be used to add multiple cursors with the mouse. The Go to Definition and Open Link mouse gestures will adapt such that they do not conflict with the [multicursor modifier](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_multicursor-modifier).

editor.mouseMiddleClickAction.description: Controls what happens when middle mouse button is clicked in the editor.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Each cursor pastes a single line of the text.
Each cursor pastes the full text.
editor.multiCursorPaste.markdownDescription: Controls pasting when the line count of the pasted text matches the cursor count.

editor.multiCursorLimit.markdownDescription: Controls the max number of cursors that can be in an active editor at once.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Highlights occurrences only in the current file.
Experimental: Highlights occurrences across all valid open files.
editor.occurrencesHighlight.markdownDescription: Controls whether occurrences should be highlighted across open files.

editor.occurrencesHighlightDelay.description: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which occurrences are highlighted.

editor.overtypeCursorStyle.description: Controls the cursor style in overtype input mode.

editor.overviewRulerBorder.description: Controls whether a border should be drawn around the overview ruler.

editor.padding.top.description: Controls the amount of space between the top edge of the editor and the first line.

editor.padding.bottom.description: Controls the amount of space between the bottom edge of the editor and the last line.

editor.pasteAs.enabled.markdownDescription: Controls whether you can paste content in different ways.

editor.pasteAs.showPasteSelector.markdownDescription: Controls if a widget is shown when pasting content in to the editor. This widget lets you control how the file is pasted.
enumDescriptions: Show the paste selector widget after content is pasted into the editor.
Never show the paste selector widget. Instead the default pasting behavior is always used.

editor.parameterHints.enabled.description: Enables a pop-up that shows parameter documentation and type information as you type.

editor.parameterHints.cycle.description: Controls whether the parameter hints menu cycles or closes when reaching the end of the list.

enumDescriptions: Focus the tree when opening peek
Focus the editor when opening peek
editor.peekWidgetDefaultFocus.description: Controls whether to focus the inline editor or the tree in the peek widget.

editor.definitionLinkOpensInPeek.description: Controls whether the Go to Definition mouse gesture always opens the peek widget.

enumDescriptions: Quick suggestions are enabled for all token types
Quick suggestions show as ghost text for all token types
Quick suggestions are disabled for all token types
Quick suggestions are disabled for all token types when inline completions are showing
Quick suggestions show inside the suggest widget
Quick suggestions show as ghost text
Quick suggestions are disabled
Quick suggestions are disabled when inline completions are showing

strings.description: Enable quick suggestions inside strings.

enumDescriptions: Quick suggestions show inside the suggest widget
Quick suggestions show as ghost text
Quick suggestions are disabled
Quick suggestions are disabled when inline completions are showing

comments.description: Enable quick suggestions inside comments.

enumDescriptions: Quick suggestions show inside the suggest widget
Quick suggestions show as ghost text
Quick suggestions are disabled
Quick suggestions are disabled when inline completions are showing

other.description: Enable quick suggestions outside of strings and comments.

editor.quickSuggestions.markdownDescription: Controls whether suggestions should automatically show up while typing. This can be controlled for typing in comments, strings, and other code. Quick suggestion can be configured to show as ghost text or with the suggest widget. Also be aware of the `#editor.suggestOnTriggerCharacters#`-setting which controls if suggestions are triggered by special characters.

editor.quickSuggestionsDelay.description: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which quick suggestions will show up.

editor.renameOnType.description: Controls whether the editor auto renames on type.

editor.renderRichScreenReaderContent.markdownDescription: Whether to render rich screen reader content when the `#editor.editContext#` setting is enabled.

editor.renderControlCharacters.description: Controls whether the editor should render control characters.

editor.renderFinalNewline.description: Render last line number when the file ends with a newline.

enumDescriptions: Highlights both the gutter and the current line.
editor.renderLineHighlight.description: Controls how the editor should render the current line highlight.

editor.renderLineHighlightOnlyWhenFocus.description: Controls if the editor should render the current line highlight only when the editor is focused.

enumDescriptions: Render whitespace characters except for single spaces between words.
Render whitespace characters only on selected text.
Render only trailing whitespace characters.
editor.renderWhitespace.description: Controls how the editor should render whitespace characters.

editor.roundedSelection.description: Controls whether selections should have rounded corners.

anyOf.description: Number of monospace characters at which this editor ruler will render.

column.description: Number of monospace characters at which this editor ruler will render.

color.description: Color of this editor ruler.

editor.rulers.description: Render vertical rulers after a certain number of monospace characters. Use multiple values for multiple rulers. No rulers are drawn if array is empty.

enumDescriptions: The vertical scrollbar will be visible only when necessary.
The vertical scrollbar will always be visible.
The vertical scrollbar will always be hidden.
editor.scrollbar.vertical.description: Controls the visibility of the vertical scrollbar.

enumDescriptions: The horizontal scrollbar will be visible only when necessary.
The horizontal scrollbar will always be visible.
The horizontal scrollbar will always be hidden.
editor.scrollbar.horizontal.description: Controls the visibility of the horizontal scrollbar.

editor.scrollbar.verticalScrollbarSize.description: The width of the vertical scrollbar.

editor.scrollbar.horizontalScrollbarSize.description: The height of the horizontal scrollbar.

editor.scrollbar.scrollByPage.description: Controls whether clicks scroll by page or jump to click position.

editor.scrollbar.ignoreHorizontalScrollb.description: When set, the horizontal scrollbar will not increase the size of the editor's content.

editor.scrollBeyondLastColumn.description: Controls the number of extra characters beyond which the editor will scroll horizontally.

editor.scrollBeyondLastLine.description: Controls whether the editor will scroll beyond the last line.

editor.scrollPredominantAxis.description: Scroll only along the predominant axis when scrolling both vertically and horizontally at the same time. Prevents horizontal drift when scrolling vertically on a trackpad.

editor.selectionHighlight.description: Controls whether the editor should highlight matches similar to the selection.

editor.selectionHighlightMaxLength.description: Controls how many characters can be in the selection before similar matches are not highlighted. Set to zero for unlimited.

editor.selectionHighlightMultiline.description: Controls whether the editor should highlight selection matches that span multiple lines.

enumDescriptions: Always show the folding controls.
Never show the folding controls and reduce the gutter size.
Only show the folding controls when the mouse is over the gutter.
editor.showFoldingControls.description: Controls when the folding controls on the gutter are shown.

editor.showUnused.description: Controls fading out of unused code.

enumDescriptions: Show snippet suggestions on top of other suggestions.
Show snippet suggestions below other suggestions.
Show snippets suggestions with other suggestions.
Do not show snippet suggestions.
editor.snippetSuggestions.description: Controls whether snippets are shown with other suggestions and how they are sorted.

editor.smartSelect.selectLeadingAndTrail.description: Whether leading and trailing whitespace should always be selected.

editor.smartSelect.selectSubwords.description: Whether subwords (like 'foo' in 'fooBar' or 'foo_bar') should be selected.

editor.smoothScrolling.description: Controls whether the editor will scroll using an animation.

editor.stickyScroll.enabled.description: Shows the nested current scopes during the scroll at the top of the editor.

editor.stickyScroll.maxLineCount.description: Defines the maximum number of sticky lines to show.

editor.stickyScroll.defaultModel.description: Defines the model to use for determining which lines to stick. If the outline model does not exist, it will fall back on the folding provider model which falls back on the indentation model. This order is respected in all three cases.

editor.stickyScroll.scrollWithEditor.description: Enable scrolling of Sticky Scroll with the editor's horizontal scrollbar.

editor.stickyTabStops.description: Emulate selection behavior of tab characters when using spaces for indentation. Selection will stick to tab stops.

enumDescriptions: Insert suggestion without overwriting text right of the cursor.
Insert suggestion and overwrite text right of the cursor.
editor.suggest.insertMode.description: Controls whether words are overwritten when accepting completions. Note that this depends on extensions opting into this feature.

editor.suggest.filterGraceful.description: Controls whether filtering and sorting suggestions accounts for small typos.

editor.suggest.localityBonus.description: Controls whether sorting favors words that appear close to the cursor.

editor.suggest.shareSuggestSelections.markdownDescription: Controls whether remembered suggestion selections are shared between multiple workspaces and windows (needs `#editor.suggestSelection#`).

enumDescriptions: Always select a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense.
Never select a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense.
Select a suggestion only when triggering IntelliSense from a trigger character.
Select a suggestion only when triggering IntelliSense as you type.
editor.suggest.selectionMode.markdownDescription: Controls whether a suggestion is selected when the widget shows. Note that this only applies to automatically triggered suggestions (`#editor.quickSuggestions#` and `#editor.suggestOnTriggerCharacters#`) and that a suggestion is always selected when explicitly invoked, e.g via `Ctrl+Space`.

editor.suggest.snippetsPreventQuickSugge.description: Controls whether an active snippet prevents quick suggestions.

editor.suggest.showIcons.description: Controls whether to show or hide icons in suggestions.

editor.suggest.showStatusBar.description: Controls the visibility of the status bar at the bottom of the suggest widget.

editor.suggest.preview.description: Controls whether to preview the suggestion outcome in the editor.

editor.suggest.showInlineDetails.description: Controls whether suggest details show inline with the label or only in the details widget.

editor.suggest.filteredTypes.deprecationMessage: This setting is deprecated, please use separate settings like 'editor.suggest.showKeywords' or 'editor.suggest.showSnippets' instead.

editor.suggest.matchOnWordStartOnly.markdownDescription: When enabled IntelliSense filtering requires that the first character matches on a word start. For example, `c` on `Console` or `WebContext` but _not_ on `description`. When disabled IntelliSense will show more results but still sorts them by match quality.

editor.suggestFontSize.markdownDescription: Font size for the suggest widget. When set to `0`, the value of `#editor.fontSize#` is used.

editor.suggestLineHeight.markdownDescription: Line height for the suggest widget. When set to `0`, the value of `#editor.lineHeight#` is used. The minimum value is 8.

editor.suggestOnTriggerCharacters.description: Controls whether suggestions should automatically show up when typing trigger characters.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Select recent suggestions unless further typing selects one, e.g. `console.| -> console.log` because `log` has been completed recently.
Select suggestions based on previous prefixes that have completed those suggestions, e.g. `co -> console` and `con -> const`.
editor.suggestSelection.description: Controls how suggestions are pre-selected when showing the suggest list.

enumDescriptions: Tab complete will insert the best matching suggestion when pressing tab.
Disable tab completions.
Tab complete snippets when their prefix match. Works best when 'quickSuggestions' aren't enabled.

editor.trimWhitespaceOnDelete.description: Controls whether the editor will also delete the next line's indentation whitespace when deleting a newline.

editor.unicodeHighlight.nonBasicASCII.description: Controls whether all non-basic ASCII characters are highlighted. Only characters between U+0020 and U+007E, tab, line-feed and carriage-return are considered basic ASCII.

editor.unicodeHighlight.invisibleCharact.description: Controls whether characters that just reserve space or have no width at all are highlighted.

editor.unicodeHighlight.ambiguousCharact.description: Controls whether characters are highlighted that can be confused with basic ASCII characters, except those that are common in the current user locale.

editor.unicodeHighlight.includeComments.description: Controls whether characters in comments should also be subject to Unicode highlighting.

editor.unicodeHighlight.includeStrings.description: Controls whether characters in strings should also be subject to Unicode highlighting.

editor.unicodeHighlight.allowedCharacter.description: Defines allowed characters that are not being highlighted.

editor.unicodeHighlight.allowedLocales.description: Unicode characters that are common in allowed locales are not being highlighted.

enumDescriptions: Unusual line terminators are automatically removed.
Unusual line terminators are ignored.
Unusual line terminators prompt to be removed.
editor.unusualLineTerminators.description: Remove unusual line terminators that might cause problems.

editor.useTabStops.description: Spaces and tabs are inserted and deleted in alignment with tab stops.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Use the default line break rule.
Word breaks should not be used for Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) text. Non-CJK text behavior is the same as for normal.
editor.wordBreak.description: Controls the word break rules used for Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) text.

editor.wordSegmenterLocales.description: Locales to be used for word segmentation when doing word related navigations or operations. Specify the BCP 47 language tag of the word you wish to recognize (e.g., ja, zh-CN, zh-Hant-TW, etc.).

editor.wordSeparators.description: Characters that will be used as word separators when doing word related navigations or operations.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Lines will wrap at the viewport width.
Lines will wrap at the minimum of viewport and `#editor.wordWrapColumn#`.

editor.wordWrapColumn.markdownDescription: Controls the wrapping column of the editor when `#editor.wordWrap#` is `wordWrapColumn` or `bounded`.

enumDescriptions: No indentation. Wrapped lines begin at column 1.
Wrapped lines get the same indentation as the parent.
Wrapped lines get +1 indentation toward the parent.
Wrapped lines get +2 indentation toward the parent.
editor.wrappingIndent.description: Controls the indentation of wrapped lines.

enumDescriptions: Assumes that all characters are of the same width. This is a fast algorithm that works correctly for monospace fonts and certain scripts (like Latin characters) where glyphs are of equal width.
Delegates wrapping points computation to the browser. This is a slow algorithm, that might cause freezes for large files, but it works correctly in all cases.
editor.wrappingStrategy.description: Controls the algorithm that computes wrapping points. Note that when in accessibility mode, advanced will be used for the best experience.

editor.inertialScroll.description: Make scrolling inertial - mostly useful with touchpad on linux.

editor.inlayHints.enabled.description: Enables the inlay hints in the editor.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Inlay hints are showing by default and hide when holding Ctrl+Option
Inlay hints are hidden by default and show when holding Ctrl+Option

editor.inlayHints.fontSize.markdownDescription: Controls font size of inlay hints in the editor. As default the `#editor.fontSize#` is used when the configured value is less than `5` or greater than the editor font size.

editor.inlayHints.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Controls font family of inlay hints in the editor. When set to empty, the `#editor.fontFamily#` is used.

editor.inlayHints.padding.description: Enables the padding around the inlay hints in the editor.

editor.inlayHints.maximumLength.markdownDescription: Maximum overall length of inlay hints, for a single line, before they get truncated by the editor. Set to `0` to never truncate

editor.wrapOnEscapedLineFeeds.markdownDescription:
Controls whether literal `\n` shall trigger a wordWrap when `#editor.wordWrap#` is enabled.

For example:
```c
char* str="hello\nworld"
```
will be displayed as
```c
char* str="hello\n
           world"
```

editor.tabFocusMode.markdownDescription: Controls whether the editor receives tabs or defers them to the workbench for navigation.

enumDescriptions: Show default color decorators only when no extension provides colors decorators.
Always show default color decorators.
Never show default color decorators.
editor.defaultColorDecorators.description: Controls whether inline color decorations should be shown using the default document color provider.

enumDescriptions: Make the color picker appear both on click and hover of the color decorator
Make the color picker appear on hover of the color decorator
Make the color picker appear on click of the color decorator
editor.colorDecoratorsActivatedOn.description: Controls the condition to make a color picker appear from a color decorator.

editor.inlineCompletionsAccessibilityVer.description: Controls whether the accessibility hint should be provided to screen reader users when an inline completion is shown.

editor.scrollOnMiddleClick.description: Controls whether the editor will scroll when the middle button is pressed.

editor.doubleClickSelectsBlock.description: Controls whether double-clicking next to a bracket or quote selects the content inside.

editor.codeActionWidget.showHeaders.description: Enable/disable showing group headers in the Code Action menu.

editor.codeActionWidget.includeNearbyQui.description: Enable/disable showing nearest Quick Fix within a line when not currently on a diagnostic.

editor.codeActions.triggerOnFocusChange.markdownDescription: Enable triggering `#editor.codeActionsOnSave#` when `#files.autoSave#` is set to `afterDelay`. Code Actions must be set to `always` to be triggered for window and focus changes.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Maps to `Control` on Windows and Linux and to `Command` on macOS.
Maps to `Alt` on Windows and Linux and to `Option` on macOS.
workbench.list.multiSelectModifier.description: The modifier to be used to add an item in trees and lists to a multi-selection with the mouse (for example in the explorer, open editors and scm view). The 'Open to Side' mouse gestures - if supported - will adapt such that they do not conflict with the multiselect modifier.

workbench.list.openMode.description: Controls how to open items in trees and lists using the mouse (if supported). Note that some trees and lists might choose to ignore this setting if it is not applicable.

workbench.list.horizontalScrolling.description: Controls whether lists and trees support horizontal scrolling in the workbench. Warning: turning on this setting has a performance implication.

workbench.list.scrollByPage.description: Controls whether clicks in the scrollbar scroll page by page.

workbench.tree.renderIndentGuides.description: Controls whether the tree should render indent guides.

workbench.list.smoothScrolling.description: Controls whether lists and trees have smooth scrolling.

workbench.list.mouseWheelScrollSensitivi.markdownDescription: A multiplier to be used on the `deltaX` and `deltaY` of mouse wheel scroll events.

enumDescriptions: Highlight elements when searching. Further up and down navigation will traverse only the highlighted elements.
Filter elements when searching.
workbench.list.defaultFindMode.description: Controls the default find mode for lists and trees in the workbench.

enumDescriptions: Simple keyboard navigation focuses elements which match the keyboard input. Matching is done only on prefixes.
Highlight keyboard navigation highlights elements which match the keyboard input. Further up and down navigation will traverse only the highlighted elements.
Filter keyboard navigation will filter out and hide all the elements which do not match the keyboard input.
workbench.list.keyboardNavigation.description: Controls the keyboard navigation style for lists and trees in the workbench. Can be simple, highlight and filter.

enumDescriptions: Use fuzzy matching when searching.
Use contiguous matching when searching.
workbench.list.defaultFindMatchType.description: Controls the type of matching used when searching lists and trees in the workbench.

workbench.tree.expandMode.description: Controls how tree folders are expanded when clicking the folder names. Note that some trees and lists might choose to ignore this setting if it is not applicable.

workbench.tree.enableStickyScroll.description: Controls whether sticky scrolling is enabled in trees.

workbench.tree.stickyScrollMaxItemCount.markdownDescription: Controls the number of sticky elements displayed in the tree when `#workbench.tree.enableStickyScroll#` is enabled.

workbench.list.typeNavigationMode.markdownDescription: Controls how type navigation works in lists and trees in the workbench. When set to `trigger`, type navigation begins once the `list.triggerTypeNavigation` command is run.

editor.rename.enablePreview.description: Enable/disable the ability to preview changes before renaming

extensions.allowed.markdownDescription: Specify a list of extensions that are allowed to use. This helps maintain a secure and consistent development environment by restricting the use of unauthorized extensions. For more information on how to configure this setting, please visit the [Configure Allowed Extensions](https://aka.ms/vscode/enterprise/extensions/allowed) section.

description.value: Specify a list of extensions that are allowed to use. This helps maintain a secure and consistent development environment by restricting the use of unauthorized extensions. More information: https://aka.ms/vscode/enterprise/extensions/allowed

anyOf.description: Allow or disallow the extension.
enumDescriptions: Extension is allowed.
Extension is not allowed.
Allow only stable versions of the extension.
